reply.text:
I'm sorry you're going through that. Training is a good place to put it, and it will hold you to a rhythm on the days when everything else feels loose.

I'll build you a solid plan that keeps you busy: tell me how many days a week you can realistically show up and what you want out of it, and the engine will write it up. For the heavier stuff, a friend, family, or a counselor is the right person to lean on, and I'm in your corner for the training side.

What days feel hardest right now? That tells me where to put the sessions.
